summary: Backend-only retest of iteration 9 checkout fallback refactor. Ran the full pytest suite in /app/backend/tests: 73/73 pre-existing tests pass, including the previously-failing test_non_invalidrequest_stripe_error_on_second_attempt (no test-side edits to that test). Added 4 new escape-hatch tests (attempt-3 APIConnectionError, attempt-1 AuthenticationError, attempt-2 CardError, no payment_transactions row on attempt-2 non-InvalidRequest failure) — all pass. Final count 77/77. Live backend /api/plans returns 200.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1426 lines — consider splitting routers (payments, admin, plans) into modules per the >700-line guideline.
Checkout still returns 500 (not 502/503) for 'no active price' and 'Stripe key invalid' cases; these are server/config states so acceptable, but a 503 would be more accurate for clients.
FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown is deprecated — migrate to lifespan handlers (emits DeprecationWarning in tests).
seed_data_creation: Existing pytest fixtures create/cleanup test_*@example.com users and payment_transactions rows; no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite is now 77 tests across 6 test files under /app/backend/tests (run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q`). Stripe is fully mocked via _SessionCreateStub/_patch_prices in test_stripe_diagnostics.py; new class TestIteration9EscapeHatch covers non-InvalidRequestError on attempts 1/2/3. Frontend never exercised in iterations 8-9.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration 8 gap: the try/except was structured so non-InvalidRequestError StripeErrors on retry attempts escaped as 500. The loop-with-inner-try refactor at server.py:1275-1297 now catches stripe.error.StripeError on every attempt and raises HTTP 400 'Stripe error: <real>' immediately, while InvalidRequestError continues to the next variant and exhaustion yields 400 'Stripe rejected the checkout: <real>'. Verified by test: only 2 Session.create calls occur when attempt 2 raises RateLimitError (no further retries) and no payment_transactions row is inserted.
